understanding: Le capteur de mouvement détecte une perturbation et déclenche un signal électrique en réponse.

candidates.action: An orange perturbation wave visibly distorts as it enters the sensor, directly triggering a yellow signal from the sensor's core.
candidates.explains: Shows the cause (perturbation) and effect (signal) relationship.
candidates.misses: Does not detail how the signal travels in the circuit.

candidates.action: The sensor lights up internally, and a quick succession of yellow signals moves outward from the core.
candidates.explains: Indicates the signal initiation and its pathway through the electronics.
candidates.misses: Lacks emphasis on the initial perturbation causing this response.

candidates.action: A yellow signal pulses from the sensor's core and travels through the visible electronic circuit parts, lighting them up sequentially.
candidates.explains: Illustrates how the signal travels through the entire circuit.
candidates.misses: Does not clearly connect the signal's initiation with a perturbation.

chosen: An orange perturbation wave visibly distorts as it enters the sensor, directly triggering a yellow signal from the sensor's core.
why_chosen: It clearly depicts the cause (perturbation) and effect (signal initiation) relationship, ensuring that the viewer sees why the signal is generated.
